title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in an Array
description: Find the maximum XOR result of two numbers in an array.
pseudocode:
1. max = 0, mask = 0
2. for i from 31 down to 0:
3.   mask |= (1 << i)
4.   prefixes = set()
5.   for num in nums:
6.     prefixes.add(num & mask)
7.   greedy = max | (1 << i)
8.   for p in prefixes:
9.     if (greedy ^ p) in prefixes:
10.      max = greedy
11.      break

steps.note: Update mask for bit 3 (last bit for 0-31 range in small case).
Check if XOR target exists in prefix set.
